test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the given options best describes the truthfulness of the following statements?

**Statement - 1 : **Under Self Balancing Ledger system each ledger is prepared under double entry system and a complete trial balance can also be prepared by taking up the balances of ledger accounts.

**Statement - 2 :** Under Self Balancing Ledger system three ledger accounts are prepared, viz, General Ledger Adjustment Account, which is maintained under Debtors Ledger and Creditors Ledger and Debtors or Sales Ledger Adjustment Account and Creditors or Purchase Ledger Adjustments Accounts, which are maintained under General Ledger.

options.text: Both statement - 1 and statement - 2 are incorrect
Both statement - 1 and statement - 2 are correct

solution:
The correct answer is** Both statement - 1 and statement - 2 are correct.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement - 1: Under Self Balancing Ledger system each ledger is prepared under double entry system and a complete trial balance can also be prepared by taking up the balances of ledger accounts:**

 
 
• Under the Self Balancing Ledger system, each ledger (General Ledger, Debtors Ledger, and Creditors Ledger) is maintained using the double entry system.
 
• This ensures that every transaction is recorded in two accounts, maintaining the accounting equation and allowing for a complete trial balance to be prepared.
 
• Each ledger can provide a trial balance independently, which helps in detecting errors within that specific ledger.
 
 
 
• **Statement - 2: Under Self Balancing Ledger system three ledger accounts are prepared, viz, General Ledger Adjustment Account, which is maintained under Debtors Ledger and Creditors Ledger and Debtors or Sales Ledger Adjustment Account and Creditors or Purchase Ledger Adjustments Accounts, which are maintained under General Ledger:**
 
 
• In the Self Balancing Ledger system, three specific adjustment accounts are maintained to ensure that the ledgers are self-balancing.
 
• The General Ledger Adjustment Account is created in the Debtors Ledger and Creditors Ledger to reflect the total balances of these ledgers in the General Ledger.
 
• The Debtors or Sales Ledger Adjustment Account and Creditors or Purchase Ledger Adjustment Account are maintained in the General Ledger to reflect the balances of the Debtors Ledger and Creditors Ledger respectively.
 
• This system helps in cross-verifying the balances and ensures accuracy in the accounting records.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Both statement - 1 and statement - 2 are incorrect:**

 
 
• This is incorrect because both statements accurately describe the workings of the Self Balancing Ledger system.
 
 
 
• **Only statement - 2 is correct:**
 
 
• This is incorrect because statement - 1 is also a correct description of the Self Balancing Ledger system.
 
 
 
• **Only statement - 1 is correct:**
 
 
• This is incorrect because statement - 2 is also a correct description of the Self Balancing Ledger system.
